text.p: The settings here are for connecting from $PNAME to the DevAlert Service, using your DevAlert login.
Enter your username (the email address used for DevAlert Console).
The password handling is by default not saved, but check the Remember Password button to save it (encrypted).
The Test button will try to connect to the DevAlert Console, to verify if your settings are correct.
If your DevAlert is set up with many Products, and you do not want to see them all, you can set up a filter using the Change... button.
